backend/main.mo: Defines storage-mixin actor with types for render-order rules and GenesisCraft preview metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing major frontend pages, components, and config behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/styles defining CSS variables for light/dark themes and applying global background and border styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML wrapper loading the root React app and main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing routing, state persistence, project schemas, and lazy-loaded views.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions using alert-dialog components and confirm store.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: Dialog for creating a new project with fields for name, symbol, size, and pixel art mode.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: Clickable tile that starts the project creation flow.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: Dialog for editing an existing project's name, symbol, size, and pixel art mode.
Displays project metadata with open, settings, and delete actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer with branding, heart icon, and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with navigation, mobile menu, project info, and save status indicator.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Tooltip wrapper showing text on hover or focus with animated popover.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports lightweight inline SVG icon components to replace external icon library imports.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Animated icon button component with scaling, transitions, and focus styles.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: Dialog explaining how to obtain a Pinata JWT token with step-by-step instructions and warnings.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Displays a fixed-width status label based on save state with minimal layout shift.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Provides lock, unlock, and IPFS upload controls for a project's generated NFTs, managing publishing state and progress.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle component to switch between compact and grid views.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand-powered confirmation dialog store and a promise-based confirm function for destructive actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login flow, and identity loading via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Debounces and validates a Pinata JWT key, exposing status and messages based on async validation results.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting that no backend queries are needed due to localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styles, CSS variables, motion settings, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Implements NFT builder UI with layer previews, trait selection, file uploads, and token generation logic.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays project list with creation, editing, deletion, and confirmation handling via the destructive confirm hook.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Renders a canvas preview of layered traits, supports random shuffling with rule validation, and merges selected trait images into a final composite.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Provides UI for editing and normalizing trait rarity weights per layer, including locking, proportional updates, and automatic initialization.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of trait compatibility rules, with a modal-based UI and validation checks.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Handles project-level settings such as metadata format, blockchain selection, creator management, and Pinata API validation.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Controls NFT generation, filtering, sorting, caching, and ZIP export, communicating with a worker via a custom protocol.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: React UI for managing layers and traits, including adding, editing, deleting, and updating project rules.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading NFT images and metadata to IPFS via Pinata with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Generates metadata objects for NFTs based on project settings and target blockchain formats.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Provides atomic project save/load utilities using localStorage with legacy cleanup and size checks.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Utility for validating Pinata JWTs and uploading files, directories, and JSON to IPFS.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines message types and data structures for worker-based NFT generation and communication.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Utility to yield execution to keep the UI responsive during long tasks.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Web worker handling NFT generation logic including trait selection, rule checks, DNA creation, and optional OffscreenCanvas image compositing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, spacing, typography, animations, and enabling dark mode with custom design tokens.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current NFT engine state, feature roadmap, and planned multi-chain export support changes.
